titleTr: Okulda bir gün: Genelde ve şu an

grammar.topic: Present Simple ile Present Continuous farkı ve stative verbs
explainTr: Present Simple rutinleri, alışkanlıkları ve genel gerçekleri anlatır: The bell rings at eight. Present Continuous şu an olan işi anlatır: The students are writing now.

Bazı fiiller durum, duygu ya da düşünce bildirir (stative): know, understand, want, need, like, love, have (sahip olmak). Bunlar genelde -ing almaz: I understand. (I am understanding değil.) She wants a pencil.
Soru yaparken ipucuna bak: every day, usually, often → Do/Does. now, right now, at the moment, Look! → Am/Is/Are + -ing.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'anlıyorum' şu anı da alışkanlığı da kapsar. İngilizcede 'anlıyorum' için I understand (Present Simple) dersin; 'I am understanding' yanlıştır. 'Şu an yürüyorum' ise I am walking.
table: I know. I want. I need.

reading.title: A day at Lincoln Elementary
reading.text:
Today Hafsa is a visitor at Lincoln Elementary School. She usually works in the cafeteria, but this morning she is watching Ms. Carter's class. The bell rings at eight thirty, and the students come in. Ms. Carter takes attendance every day, and she knows all the names.

Right now, the students are writing in their notebooks. Ms. Carter is walking around the room. She helps a boy who doesn't understand the lesson. Hafsa wants to learn, too, so she is taking notes.

At ten thirty, it is recess. The children run outside and play. They usually eat lunch at noon in the cafeteria, and Hafsa often helps there. The principal, Mr. Adams, sometimes visits the classrooms. He is smiling at the students now. Hafsa thinks, "I love this place. I want to work in a classroom someday."

questions.whyTr: Metin: 'She usually works in the cafeteria'.

questions.q: What are the students doing right now?
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'the students are writing in their notebooks'.

questions.q: What does Hafsa want to do someday?
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'I want to work in a classroom someday.'

listening.title: Mr. Brown calls a substitute teacher

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Hello, Hafsa. This is Mr. Brown from Lincoln Elementary. Are you busy right now?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Hello, Mr. Brown. I'm cooking dinner, but I can talk.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Good. Ms. Carter is sick tomorrow. Do you want to help in her class?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Really? I want to, but I'm not a teacher.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: You don't need to teach. The principal is looking for an assistant for the day.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Oh, I see. What do I do?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: You help the students, and you take attendance. Ms. Carter is writing a lesson plan now. She is sending it by email.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Does the class start at eight thirty?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Yes, it does. The bell rings at eight thirty. Please come at eight.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I understand. Where is the room?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: It's in the hallway on the left. I am standing there now, and the door is open.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Great, I'm very happy. Thank you!

questions.q: Why does Mr. Brown call Hafsa?
questions.whyTr: Mr. Brown: 'Ms. Carter is sick tomorrow.'
Mr. Brown: 'You help the students, and you take attendance.'
Mr. Brown: 'The bell rings at eight thirty.'

options: She is walking in the hallway.

writing.promptTr: Okulda bir günü anlat (5-6 cümle): genelde ne olur, şu an ne oluyor?
writing.promptEn: Write 5-6 sentences about a school day. What usually happens, and what is happening now?
writing.model: Every day, the bell rings at eight thirty. The students usually write in their notebooks. At ten thirty, they go to recess. Right now, the teacher is helping a student. I want to work in a school someday.
